title: TikTok Hellhound Apocalypse
description: A giant black demonic dog with flaming spiral ears, glowing orange TikTok-logo eyes, and a torn ruff collar stands as a massive archway over a broken highway. The hellish landscape shows burning cities, wrecked cars, floating dog treats, and flames under a dramatic orange and purple sky.
prompt: A towering black demonic hellhound with glowing orange TikTok logo eyes, flaming spiral ears in pink green and orange, wearing a torn Elizabethan ruff, stands as a massive arch over a collapsing highway filled with wrecked cars and abandoned vehicles. Burning dystopian city in the background under a fiery apocalyptic sunset sky with dramatic clouds, floating dog treats and flaming paw prints, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene
